scene_cut_detection — VIDEOSTREAM analysis op

• Data kinds: video → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.scene_cut_detection(video, bins: 'int' = 64, threshold: 'float' = 0.3) -> 'dict' (implementation को सीधे call करना हो तो import videostream; videostream.scene_cut_detection(video, bins: 'int' = 64, threshold: 'float' = 0.3) -> 'dict', registry से लेना हो तो opsvideostream.get("scene_cut_detection"))

उपयोग

clip पर shot-boundary chi-square histogram दूरी → {"distance", "cut", "n"} (table)।

> नीचे का विस्तृत विवरण मूल text में है — सारांश और headings का अनुवाद हो चुका है।

distance[t] is the chi-square distance of frame t's histogram to frame t−1's (distance[0] = 0); cut[t] is distance[t] > threshold. Streaming form: one histogram of state, no frames kept.
